source_scope: 132 source packages, 313 raw members, 54 decoded original Texture2Ds; declared roots are skill GA -> seven actual Cascade systems -> materials -> textures/SubUV.

adaptation.engine: Unity native sprite rig; no UE code/Blueprint/shader executes
adaptation.composition: Precomposed original-texture layers, finite life, RG SubUV channel masks, alpha conversion; original ink RGBA kept
adaptation.orientation: positive X leading edge and negative X flame wake via counterclockwise 90-degree source projection; actor engine mirrors left
adaptation.timing: 60 Hz BBEE finite timelines, separate 90-tick flight and 24-tick hit; no eight-frame placeholder
adaptation.pixel_density: Each effect clip sampled to a maximum 96-pixel canvas with a declared fixed world scale; source body sampling and the native 16-page memory cap stay fixed
limits: Not an exact Cascade simulation or lossless shader copy
Original distortion, native mesh deformation and particle collisions are not implemented
Colors/scale/timing are declared BBEE adaptations; native scene acceptance pending
